text:
alex: Hey team — can we lock a time for the retrospective on the P99 latency incident? Need to confirm attendees and a short agenda. Prefer next Tue or Wed afternoon.

maria: next wed works for me (afternoon).

jordan: I can do Tue 3pm or Wed 4pm. Prefer Tue to get actions earlier.

priyanka: +1 Tue afternoon. Will need about 20 mins to walk through the tracing deck.

alex: OK tentatively Tue 15:00 PT then. Proposed attendee list: oncall (Sam), infra lead (Jordan), runtime eng (Priyanka), product (Maria), SRE (Alex), and incident owner. Anyone missing?

sam: I can attend. Do we want legal/comms for the customer note?

maria: For this one, we can do comms async — I'll draft the customer blurb after the retro, unless there are open questions. Legal not required.

alex: Agenda idea (30m total):
```
- 5m: quick timeline + facts (who/what/when)
- 10m: root cause & contributing factors (data + tracing)
- 10m: actions & owners (1 commit per action)
- 5m: follow-ups + owner deadlines
```

jordan: Suggest we add "rollback/fallback decision points" to the actions section so we capture operational playbook changes.

priyanka: Good call. Also want to capture a perf test that reproduces the tail latency; I'll add an issue.

engbot: Reminder: link your postmortem doc here and add an owner tag using `#owner` in the doc heading.

alex: Action items before the meeting (please):
- add short bullet timeline to the PM section (owner: Maria)
- attach link to traces + logs (owner: Jordan)
- create reproducible perf test ticket (owner: Priyanka)
- list immediate mitigations and who executed them (owner: Sam)

sam: noted — will paste the mitigation timeline and the runbook steps I used.

maria: I'll draft the two-paragraph customer update after the retro and post to #customer-updates for review.

priyanka: I created the perf ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf/issues/212 — please react with :eyes: if you want access.

alex: Can folks add availability as a quick emoji poll here? If we hit a conflict I'll move to Wed 16:00.

jordan: :thumbsup: for Tue 15:00

sam: :thumbsup:

priyanka: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

alex: Great — locking Tue 15:00 PT then. I'll create the calendar invite and include the above agenda, links, and the prework checklist. Also rotating facilitator: Jordan this time? Jordan — you ok to facilitate and note take rotation rules?

jordan: Happy to facilitate. I'll also take notes this time and open the action items in the repo (label: postmortem-action).

alex: Thanks. Post-retro follow-up plan: owner opens GH issue per action with clear acceptance criteria + due date, we triage those in next weekly ops sync. If any action affects customers, mark as P0 for comms.

engbot: Action checklist template: `- Action: <title> | Owner: @name | Due: YYYY-MM-DD | Status: open | PR: link`

maria: Sounds good. One last ask — can we add a 5m 'what went well' callout to keep balance?

alex: Yes — adding a 5m "what went well" at the top (so timeline becomes 3m and we keep total 30m).

sam: Thanks — see you all Tue.

alex: Invite sent. Thread locked for new participants but feel free to DM if you need to join.
